items.title: Musk says Tesla on the hook for Cybertruck deposits after cancellation
items.summary: Believe it or not, Tesla will have to refund some buyers a deposit placed on Cybertrucks.

items.title: Tesla planning to return deposits for many Cybertruck buyers
items.summary: The 8:30 hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley discuss Tesla CEO Elon Musk saying that Cybertruck production will be ramped up to meet the backlog of orders, but that many deposits made will be returned.

items.title: Tesla offered $5,000 to a homeowner whose $110K Solar Roof never produced power. A judge has deemed it liable for fraud
items.summary: An $82,000 contract turned into a $2.5 million problem for this homeowner.

items.title: Tesla Cybertruck production will end in mid-2027
items.summary: Cybertruck’s exit will make space for its 2-seat Cybercab, CEO Elon Musk said in a recent post on X.

items.title: Musk Is Betting Giga Texas on the Two-Seat Cybercab. Only Problem: “Limited Opportunity.”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk said Tesla will dismantle the Cybertruck line at Giga Texas around June or July next year for Cybercab, and will refund many truck deposits it can’t fill. Gary Black says a two-seat Cybercab has limited opportunity, but he concedes most rides carry one or two people, and Model Y robotaxis can take the groups.

items.title: How Tesla Stock Could Move Amid Roadster Reveal and Reported SpaceX Merger
items.summary: Speculation grows that Tesla and SpaceX could merge, potentially reshaping the investment case for Tesla’s roughly $1.4 trillion business.

items.title: Nvidia slides as CEO Huang faces board scrutiny over affair with alleged spy
items.summary: SEOUL/SYDNEY, Nov 9 (Reuters) - Nvidia shares declined on Monday after an internal investigation into whether CEO Jensen Huang had been targeted by a foreign intelligence effort put his future at the AI chipmaker under scrutiny. The internal probe followed a media report that Huang had a close relationship with a Chinese businesswoman who allegedly passed information to ‌Beijing.
